metadata.title: Mad2: all models and scores
metadata.description:
This record contains all 11,000 original Artificial Intelligence Sampling (AIS) models of the 1KLQ-derived Mad2 monomer construct with 197 modeled residues and wild-type sequence at modeled positions, their 11,000 matched Boltz2 no-MSA template-only refolds, and associated scores. There are 1,000 original AIS models from each of eleven sampling methods: AF2/AFSample2, AF3/AFSample3, OpenDDE Exact, Boltz2 Exact, BioEmu v1.1, BioEmu2-preview, SPEACH_AF, AF-Cluster, AlphaFlow-PDB, AlphaFlow-MD and ESMFlow-PDB. The first four methods used 40% stochastic MSA column masking. Both BioEmu methods used native unmasked conditioning; the other five methods retained their own native sampling protocols. All generated AIS models are retained, including native physicality-filter failures, with passed, failed and unavailable flags kept distinct. Sampling counts are not equilibrium populations.

Original AIS structures and their matched refolds are organized separately within this target record. Scores include native inference confidence where available, Boltz2 template-only refold pTM, per-residue refold pLDDT, experimental-reference TM similarity and original-AIS versus matched-refold TM similarity. Confidence values are not structural TM scores. Raw refold pLDDT values use their recorded 0–1 scale; any 0–100 display conversion is explicit. Missing native confidence is not replaced with refold confidence. Original/refold pairs are joined by model ID and both coordinate hashes.

Experimental controls are PDB 1DUJ (open) and 1S2H (closed, R133A mutant), using the 175 shared resolved target positions 3–101 and 112–187. Controls, original deposited coordinates, comparison copies and source citations are separately identified and excluded from the 11,000 AIS-model and 11,000-refold counts. The 1S2H author-numbered R133A substitution maps to target position 125; unresolved residues and construct differences remain explicit. No residues are silently trimmed from deposited originals. Original/refold TM similarity instead uses the full 197-residue predicted construct, with bidirectional full US-align searches and average-length normalization; the reported score is the mean of both directions.

The package preserves model/run/checkpoint provenance, physical-filter flags, sequence/residue mappings, scored-model identities and applicable upstream notices. PDB archive sources retain their CC0 attribution; other data and code retain their applicable rights, including AF3 output terms. A blanket license is not inferred from a software repository license. BioEmu2-preview is identified by the v0.1.0rc0 release family, the actual inference commit and checkpoint revision in provenance.

The Adk and Mad2 resources are separate target-level Zenodo records. Each target record contains both the original AIS models and matched template-only refolds; these are separate file groups within the record.

This research sponsored in part by NIH/NIGMS T32GM141865 and NIH/NIA R25AG088409. Thanks goes also to members of the Montelione Lab for useful insight and discussion: T.A Ramelot, Y.J. Huang, B.A. Shurina, and L.E. Spaman.

assets.name: target-and-settings
assets.description: Target sequence, selected settings and run/engine/checkpoint provenance. Include only inputs cleared for redistribution; no private runtime bindings, weights or bulk MSA databases.

assets.name: original-ais-models
assets.description: Exactly 11,000 original AIS predictions, organized by the eleven method keys; one canonical coordinate file per model ID. Retain native physicality-filter failures with flags.

assets.name: boltz2-template-only-refolds
assets.description: Exactly 11,000 matched Boltz2 no-MSA template-only refold coordinate files. Preserve their identities separately from original AIS coordinates.

assets.name: all-scores-and-confidence
assets.description: Native confidence where available, matched refold pTM and per-residue pLDDT, original-AIS versus experimental-reference TM tables, original-AIS versus refold TM tables, and exact ID/hash joins. Preserve units and missing values; no bulky PAE matrices or latents.

assets.name: experimental-pdb-controls
assets.description: Separately attributed original PDB CIFs, protein-only comparison copies, reference catalog, source/publication DOIs, SHA-256 values and reversible residue maps. Experimental controls are not AIS predictions or refolds.

assets.name: joint-analysis
assets.description: Reviewed existing shared-residue masks, clustering/projection outputs, variance/TM matrices, Bonsai trees and representative-state selections. Exclude draft posters with the historical six-method abstract; no new analysis is implied.

assets.name: model-lineage-and-rights
assets.description: Complete model inventory, original/native/refold identities and hashes, physical-filter status, source/run/settings/checkpoint receipts, licenses/notices and a reviewed rights manifest. Replace private paths with documented portable locators.

draft_review.authorization: Local config drafting only; packaging, Zenodo access, DOI reservation, uploads and publication remain with the user/other agent.
draft_review.record_layout: One record per target; original AIS models and refolds are separate file groups inside that record.
draft_review.access_right: Open is proposed and requires owner confirmation.
draft_review.creator_choice: The poster two-author list is proposed inline. The older shared creator profile is unchanged and is not inherited because it contains an unresolved B entry.
required_before_execution: Review scientific description, title and final cohort membership
Confirm creator names/order, ORCIDs and affiliations
Choose actual publication date and reviewed release tag
Resolve scoped rights and a valid record-level license; preserve AF3 output notices and derivatives review
Confirm access status and funding identifiers
Stage and privacy-review exactly the assets below; freeze per-target hashes; exclude draft posters, secrets, model weights, bulk PAE/MSA/latent files
Only after author review should the separate deposition agent package or upload
draft_review.funding_note: No unverified controlled-vocabulary grant IDs are inserted. R25AG088409 must not be classified as T32 from the literal acknowledgment wording.
draft_review.staging: Every asset path is relative to a future per-target data-root. That tree has not been created by this drafting task.
